title: Audited state-distinct capability-compute frontier
question: For the registered persistent-state retrieval workload, what is the minimum fraction of states reranked that preserves at least 80% of exhaustive reference capability under a state-distinct downstream task?
hypothesis: Increasing factor granularity reduces candidate occupancy, while increasing factor beam recovers coverage. A valid pooled-success capability measure should expose the computation/coverage frontier without relying on per-cell ratio averaging.

endpoints.name: capability_retention
endpoints.role: primary capability-constrained frontier endpoint; min(1, pooled selective success / pooled exhaustive success)

decision_rule.condition: For every M/configuration, compute capability_retention from pooled success counts only. A configuration is eligible exactly when that stored capability_retention >= 0.80.
decision_rule.licenses: a registered capability-constrained frontier on the corrected state-distinct workload
decision_rule.does_not_license: a universal optimum, universal sublinear retrieval, or hardware wall-clock speedup

decision_rule.condition: At each M, report the eligible configuration minimizing states_scored_over_M. Also identify fixed configurations eligible at all three M levels and report the one minimizing mean states_scored_over_M.
decision_rule.licenses: evidence for a per-M and fixed-configuration capability/computation frontier on this workload
decision_rule.does_not_license: general semantic addressing or a completed C5 proof

held_constant: same 48 training codes versus 16 held-out target codes
same task seed stream across arms
protocol_note: This registration preserves the scientific search surface. It corrects only the aggregation implementation: pooled capability is derived from aggregate success counts, then the same scalar is used for eligibility and frontier selection. The prior voided experiments are not rewritten.

result_note.reason: Pooled success counts were first averaged across the five seed cells and then cast to int before computing capability retention. For example, 5.4 exhaustive successes and 4.2 selective successes became 5 and 4, producing 0.80 instead of the unrounded pooled ratio 4.2/5.4. The resulting capability-retention and frontier eligibility values are therefore numerically distorted.
retained_diagnostics: proposal and selective recall were measured
result_note.non_promotion: No capability-constrained C5 frontier is promoted from this run.
